_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the CV PDF, index.html and protected/full-profile.html. Edit ONLY this file, then run: python3 scripts/build_all.py. Any text value may be a plain string (used everywhere) or {"web": ..., "pdf": ...} when the site and the PDF need different wording; use null to hide an item from one output. Links inside text: [text](url).

summary.pdf: Senior Security Service & Surveillance Technician with 20+ years of hands-on experience supporting live surveillance and electronic security systems in high-availability, regulated and continuously operating environments. Expert in enterprise CCTV, access control, intercom and IP network infrastructure, with a strong record of complex fault diagnosis, preventative maintenance and camera/image optimisation on live systems. Background includes ownership of a private electronics business in Greece (2003–2015), covering telecommunications, CCTV, network infrastructure and municipal broadband (MAN) deployments.
web: Senior Security Service & Surveillance Technician with strong hands-on experience supporting live surveillance and electronic security systems in high-availability environments.
Experienced in enterprise CCTV systems, fault diagnosis, preventative maintenance and camera optimisation, with solid knowledge of IP-based video networks.
Proven ability to respond to incidents, support operational teams and maintain system reliability in regulated and continuously operating sites.
Background includes ownership of a private electronics business in Greece (2003–2015), providing a broad foundation across telecommunications, CCTV, network infrastructure and customer support.
Working directly with clients across the Gold Coast and Brisbane, offering installation, service and preventative maintenance of CCTV/surveillance, access control, intercom and alarm systems.
Diagnosing and resolving system faults on site, restoring full operation with minimal disruption to the client, with clear technical reporting on completed work.
